block.createairspace.light_panel.tooltip: A _ceiling or wall light_ that joins with neighbouring panels into one _lit surface_.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
block.createairspace.light_strip.tooltip: A _light band_ that joins with neighbouring strips into one _line_.
On _floors and ceilings_ it runs the way you are _looking_. On _walls_ it runs _horizontally_, _sneak_ while placing to run it _vertically_.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
block.createairspace.floor_light.tooltip: A small _light set into the floor_ that you can walk over.
Gets _brighter_ with a _stronger signal_. Without a signal it stays _off_.
Switches between _always on_ and _brightness from redstone_. A _Wrench_ does the same.
_Recolours_ the light without using up the dye. _White_ resets it.
A floor of _steel balls_. _Physics objects_ such as assembled cargo containers _slide_ over it, players and mobs keep their grip.
block.createairspace.cargo_container.too: Build a _ULD_ from these blocks. Each block holds as much as an _Item Vault_ block. Only _Container Ports_ load and unload it. The _dock side_ shows a _lock point_ and _port points_.
When Placed in a ULD Shape
Joins into one container: _1x1x2_ is an LD2, _2x2x2_ an LD3, _3x2x2_ an LD11, _3x3x3_ an AMA. Other shapes stay _loose_.
A _Physics Assembler_ takes the whole container as _one piece_, no glue needed. The floor stays behind.
Turns the _dock side_ to the next side.
block.createairspace.container_lock.tool: Holds a cargo container. Fits _into the floor_ under it or _into the wall_ next to it. Containers _slide_ over it like over a Roller Bed.
_Pulls in_ the lock point of an assembled container like a _magnet_, lines it up, _grips_ it and pushes out its _bolts_. Nothing pulls it off again.
_Lets go_ of the container. A _Comparator_ shows whether a container is locked.
block.createairspace.container_port.tool: Sits in the _wall_ next to a docked container, like a _Portable Storage Interface_. It is placed with its front _towards you_, sneak to turn it away.
When a Container Is Locked in Front
Connects to a _port point_ that faces it, the _bolts_ on its sides run forward and lock in. _Funnels_, _chutes_ and other logistics at the port then _fill_ or _empty_ the container.
createairspace.luggage_scale.title: Luggage Scale
One light of a _PAPI_, a landing aid. Set four in a row next to the runway, the _lens facing the approach_.
Shows _white_ to pilots above its angle and _red_ to pilots below it. Every player sees the color of their _own approach_.
Set on the _back_ like other Create values. A new light next to a row gets the next lower angle, so start with the one _next to the runway_.
block.createairspace.stop_bar.tooltip.su: Red _inset lights_ across a taxiway that tell aircraft to _hold_. Placed next to each other they form one _bar_.
block.createairspace.stop_bar.tooltip.be: The _whole bar_ goes dark and the aircraft may cross.
Two _yellow lamps_ in front of a runway that flash in turns, a warning for anyone about to enter it.
block.createairspace.metal_detector.tool: A _walk-through frame_ that checks everyone passing through for _weapons and metal_, also inside luggage and packages.
Beeps, turns its lamp _red_ and gives off a _redstone signal_ for two seconds. What counts is the item tag _createairspace:security_alarm_.
block.createairspace.roller_floor.toolti: A _powered_ roller floor for cargo. It has _shafts on all four sides_: west and east drive one network, north and south a second, independent one. All floors joined into an area share both networks and pass rotation on.
Moves _physics objects_ like cargo containers across it in the direction its rollers turn. Two networks at once move them _diagonally_. Players, mobs and items are not moved.
block.createairspace.baggage_scanner.too: An _X-ray tunnel_ for the middle of a straight _belt_, placed like a Create tunnel. It encases the belt in industrial iron and screens everything passing through, including the _contents_ of luggage and packages.
Beeps, turns its lamp _red_ and gives off a _redstone signal_. Sort the item out with Create, for example with a _brass tunnel_ or _funnel_.
